NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ⚠️ | Reorganize the PR description to follow the PR guide. It still has an empty "Fixes:" line, a malformed `Fixes #<36878>`, a long unstructured change list, and two unchecked self-review items. |
| ✅ | Engage with the CZO discussion. The author posted there, and Daniel K said the PR isn't blocked on it because it extends the filter UX settled in #24200. |
| ℹ️ | No new push since the feedback, so only the description could have changed. |
| ℹ️ | The history has two "ci: retry" commits, and one large commit mixes several changes (contenteditable conversion, operator parsing, topic filtering). This doesn't meet commit discipline. |
| ℹ️ | CI is passing. The author has no merged PRs, but the linked issue #36878 is labeled "help wanted" per the CZO thread. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready", and don't add "maintainer review" yet. The author should clean up the description and commits first.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for checking in on the design thread! Before this can go to review, please fix the description per the [PR guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html) (use `Fixes: #36878` without the angle brackets, and complete the unchecked self-review items). Please also squash the "ci: retry" commits away and split the work into coherent commits, following the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html).
```
